result.title: Decentralized Bandit Learning of Markov Perfect Equilibria
result.summary: We study decentralized bandit learning in discounted infinite-horizon, general-sum Markov games with continuous actions. Agents observe the public state, but only their own realized rewards, and use simultaneous perturbation stochastic approximation to update their actions. Under strong monotonicity of the negative running-reward gradients and sufficiently small time steps, we prove that the fully decentralized procedure converges almost surely to the unique stationary Markov perfect equilibrium. We obtain an $O(n^{-1/2})$ convergence rate and present a natural extension to episodic finite-horizon learning.

AI.brief_summary: 研究连续动作、一般和马尔可夫博弈中的去中心化 bandit 学习，用同时扰动随机逼近更新动作，证明几乎必然收敛到唯一平稳 Markov 完美均衡，并给出 O(n^{-1/2}) 速率与有限时域扩展。
